name: Coastal Arts Center of Orange Beach
description: The Coastal Arts Center of Orange Beach is a multi-studio campus that overlooks scenic Wolf Bay and offers many artistic experiences with a breathtaking view. The stunning 10,000 square foot fine art gallery features a spacious two-story building displaying works by Gulf Coast artists including watercolorists, potters, painters, photographers, sculptors and textile artists. The Hot Shop is Alabama's premier hot glass blowing studio where visitors can make their own glass piece. The Clay Studio features ceramics artist Maya Blume-Cantrell creating beautiful artwork from clay, with opportunities for the public to make their own pottery. Adult art classes are available at various times of the year. The center offers summer art camps and the Coastal Arts Student Academy (CASA) for kids. Free and open to the public, the gallery features beautiful works from local artists with a broad price range of original artwork. The waterfront grounds are accessible daily and visitors are welcome to bring a picnic or bring an easel to draw or paint the breathtaking surroundings. The facility is pet friendly if your pet is leashed and has good, quiet manners.
